tasks.evidence: Invokes the accepted amazon_products group with the actual required root input query; there is no baked-in example or extra caller input. Its group owns search, extraction, confined writing and unconditional failure cleanup. A successful invocation is not assumed before execution.

Consumes the actual run_amazon_products exports and query. Executable instructions retain products/order, absences/errors, exact save evidence and its actual path; they distinguish complete, incomplete and failed outcomes and refuse to claim observed closure because that receipt is not exported. This internal report does not add an undeclared public interface. Truthfulness remains subject to the runtime evidence and oracle.

Uses the exact Browser read contract. The URL is https://www.amazon.fr/s?k= concatenated with uri_component(query), so the runtime caller value is encoded rather than replaced by a literal. observation_complete covers the whole default body, with domcontentloaded. The actual acquisition, errors and first products remain unverified.

Interprets only the whole search result. Instructions require the first at most three actually observed product links in display order, without substitution or invented products, and preserve empty/truncated/inaccessible acquisition as an explicit issue. The typed array is bounded at three with required name and URL strings. Actual selection and Amazon URL provenance require runtime enforcement and independent checking.

Sequential foreach over listed.products, with maxItems 3, parallel false and maxConcurrency 1. It executes page then product for each selected item and exports the product result for order-preserving aggregation. It cannot introduce a second search or additional product beyond the bound.

Reads the URL from the current selected product item through the exact Browser contract, with observation_complete and domcontentloaded and no narrowing selector. Delegated runtime permission checks each actual Amazon.fr HTTPS URL. The complete page/acquisition evidence is passed onward; actual navigation and accessibility are unverified.

Interprets actual pageEvidence together with selectedProduct, requiring page-derived name, description and price with the displayed currency. Instructions forbid estimation and search-result substitution and require explicit missing/ambiguous/inaccessible/error information in the result/status. Non-null string fields do not prove data exists; the oracle must check actual observed values.

Consumes the ordered consult.product aggregation and actual listed.searchReport. Instructions require Nom, Description, Prix, URL and Etat columns, preserve observed values/errors and provide a diagnostic row if no product could be visited. The shape is bounded to one through four rows of five nullable strings. Actual header/data ordering and fidelity are explicitly unverified until the writer output and independent oracle are inspected.

Calls the original Document writer with the exact path workflows/pr120-live-20261107-400/fragmentfix-amazon-20261107-07/products.xlsx, append false and rows bound directly to rows.rows. This is the sole authorized file destination. Its whole actual receipt is exported as saveEvidence and consumed by the final report. File existence, workbook shape, content and successful materialization remain unverified until execution.

The original Browser close operation is in the group always scope, covering search, product iteration and writing on success or failure. It has no conditional suppression or extra arguments. Actual closure is not assumed from this declaration; the unchanged oracle must observe the close receipt and closure probe.
